gx-gxamp.name: Amp: 12AX7 three-stage
gx-gxamp.shortDesc: Three cascaded 12AX7 triode stages; the classic guitarix high-gain preamp voice.
gx-gxamp.description: Three 12AX7 triode stages run through the guitarix tube tables with 6.5 kHz inter-stage low-pass filters, fed by the drive/wet-dry distortion block. Pregain sets how hard the first two stages are hit, Gain the third; the standard bright, saturating 12AX7 preamp.

gx-gxamp2.name: Amp: 6V6 three-stage
gx-gxamp2.shortDesc: Three 6V6 stages driven like a preamp; rounder, softer clip than the 12AX7 amps.
gx-gxamp2.description: Three stages through the 6V6 tube table with inter-stage low-pass filters, preceded by the drive/wet-dry distortion block. Sounds softer and more compressed than the 12AX7 version; Pregain and Gain set the per-stage drive.

gx-gxamp3.name: Amp: 12AU7 three-stage
gx-gxamp3.shortDesc: Three low-mu 12AU7 stages; cleaner headroom with a gentle, late breakup.
gx-gxamp3.description: Three 12AU7 triode stages through tube tables with inter-stage low-pass filters and extra make-up gain, preceded by the drive/wet-dry distortion block. The low-gain 12AU7 stays clean longer, making this the most headroom-friendly of the gxamp set.

gx-gxamp4.name: Amp: 12AU7 pre → 6V6 master
gx-gxamp4.shortDesc: 12AU7 three-stage preamp into a single-ended 6V6 master stage.
gx-gxamp4.description: Three 12AU7 triode stages (130 V tube table) feed a paralleled pair of 6V6 tube-table stages acting as a single-ended power stage, with the drive/wet-dry distortion block in between. Pregain drives the preamp, Gain pushes the 6V6 output for power-amp style compression.

gx-gxamp5.name: Amp: 12AX7 pre → 6V6 master
gx-gxamp5.shortDesc: Classic 12AX7 preamp into a 6V6 master stage; tweed-style crunch.
gx-gxamp5.description: Three 12AX7 triode stages feed a paralleled pair of 6V6 tube-table stages that act as a single-ended power stage, with the drive/wet-dry distortion block in between. Pregain sets preamp drive and Gain how hard the 6V6 output is pushed.

gx-gxamp6.name: Amp: 6DJ8 pre → 6V6 push-pull
gx-gxamp6.shortDesc: 6DJ8 preamp with local feedback into an asymmetric push-pull 6V6 output.
gx-gxamp6.description: Three 6DJ8 stages with inter-stage feedback loops feed a push-pull pair of 6V6 tube-table stages with asymmetric clipping limits, plus the drive/wet-dry block. Pregain drives the preamp and Gain the push-pull output.

gx-gxamp7.name: Amp: 12AX7 pre → 6V6 push-pull
gx-gxamp7.shortDesc: 12AX7 preamp with feedback into a push-pull 6V6 output; the fullest gxamp voice.
gx-gxamp7.description: Three 12AX7 triode stages with inter-stage feedback loops feed a push-pull pair of 6V6 tube-table stages with asymmetric clipping, with the drive/wet-dry distortion block in the chain. Pregain sets preamp drive and Gain the output-stage push.

gx-gxamp8.name: Amp: 12AU7 pre → 6V6 push-pull
gx-gxamp8.shortDesc: Clean-leaning 12AU7 preamp into a push-pull 6V6 output stage.
gx-gxamp8.description: Three 12AU7 stages (130 V table) with inter-stage feedback loops feed a push-pull pair of 6V6 tube-table stages with asymmetric clipping, plus the drive/wet-dry block. A lower-gain front end with power-amp style saturation at the back.

gx-gxamp9.name: Amp: 12AX7 with feedback
gx-gxamp9.shortDesc: Three 12AX7 stages with negative feedback around them; tighter than the plain version.
gx-gxamp9.description: Three 12AX7 triode stages through tube tables, with negative feedback wrapped around the first two stages and an envelope-following level tracker in front. Feedback tightens the response and lowers the effective gain compared with the plain 12AX7 amp.

gx-gxamp10.name: Amp: 6DJ8 three-stage
gx-gxamp10.shortDesc: Three 6DJ8 stages ending in a paralleled pair; smooth, mid-gain tube crunch.
gx-gxamp10.description: Two 6DJ8 triode stages followed by a paralleled 6DJ8 pair, all through 130 V tube tables with inter-stage low-pass filters, preceded by the drive/wet-dry distortion block. The 6DJ8 gives a smoother, less fizzy breakup than the 12AX7 amps.

gx-gxamp11.name: Amp: 12AU7 with feedback
gx-gxamp11.shortDesc: Three 12AU7 stages with inter-stage negative feedback; very clean, compressed edge.
gx-gxamp11.description: Three 12AU7 stages through 130 V tube tables with negative feedback around the first two stages and an envelope-following level tracker in front. The lowest-gain of the feedback amps: mostly clean with a soft edge when pushed.

gx-gxamp12.name: Amp: 6DJ8 pre → 6V6 master
gx-gxamp12.shortDesc: 6DJ8 three-stage preamp into a single-ended 6V6 master stage.
gx-gxamp12.description: Three 6DJ8 triode stages (130 V table) feed a paralleled pair of 6V6 tube-table stages acting as a single-ended power stage, with the drive/wet-dry block between them. Smooth preamp character with output-stage compression from the 6V6.

gx-gxamp13.name: Amp: 6DJ8 with feedback
gx-gxamp13.shortDesc: Three 6DJ8 stages with inter-stage negative feedback; smooth and controlled.
gx-gxamp13.description: Three 6DJ8 stages through 130 V tube tables with negative feedback around the first two stages and an envelope-following level tracker in front. Feedback trims the gain and evens out the response for a controlled, smooth crunch.

gx-gxamp14.name: Amp: 12AT7 three-stage
gx-gxamp14.shortDesc: Three 12AT7 stages; medium gain between the 12AX7 and 12AU7 amps.
gx-gxamp14.description: Three 12AT7 triode stages through tube tables with inter-stage low-pass filters, preceded by the drive/wet-dry distortion block. The 12AT7 sits between the 12AX7 and 12AU7 in gain, giving a punchy mid-gain preamp voice.

gx-gxamp15.name: Amp: 12AT7 pre → 6V6 master
gx-gxamp15.shortDesc: 12AT7 preamp into a single-ended 6V6 master stage.
gx-gxamp15.description: Three 12AT7 triode stages feed a paralleled pair of 6V6 tube-table stages acting as a single-ended power stage, with the drive/wet-dry block between them. Mid-gain preamp bite with 6V6 output compression as Gain is raised.

gx-gxamp16.name: Amp: 12AT7 pre → 6V6 push-pull
gx-gxamp16.shortDesc: 12AT7 preamp with feedback into a push-pull 6V6 output.
gx-gxamp16.description: Three 12AT7 stages with inter-stage feedback loops feed a push-pull pair of 6V6 tube-table stages with asymmetric clipping, plus the drive/wet-dry block. Mid-gain preamp with power-amp style push-pull saturation.

gx-gxamp17.name: Amp: 12AT7 with feedback
gx-gxamp17.shortDesc: Three 12AT7 stages with inter-stage negative feedback; tight mid-gain crunch.
gx-gxamp17.description: Three 12AT7 stages through tube tables with negative feedback around the first two stages and an envelope-following level tracker in front. Feedback tightens the response for a firmer, more controlled mid-gain sound.

gx-gxamp18.name: Amp: 6C16 three-stage
gx-gxamp18.shortDesc: Three stages through the 6C16 tube table; a hotter, more aggressive preamp.
gx-gxamp18.description: Three triode stages through the 6C16 tube table with inter-stage low-pass filters, preceded by the drive/wet-dry distortion block. Runs hotter than the 12AX7 set; Pregain and Gain set the per-stage drive.

gx-alembic-mono.name: Alembic F-2B Preamp (tone stage)
gx-alembic-mono.shortDesc: Linear DK model of the Alembic F-2B studio preamp's Fender-style tone stack.
gx-alembic-mono.description: DK circuit simulation from the schematic of the Alembic F-2B preamp, reduced to its Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack and Volume as a 5th-order filter whose coefficients follow the pot positions. Purely linear: no tube clipping, just the F-2B's voicing.

gx-gx-alembic.name: Alembic F-2B Preamp (tone stage, padded)
gx-gx-alembic.shortDesc: Same linear Alembic F-2B tone-stack model as Alembic Preamp with a fixed output pad.
gx-gx-alembic.description: Identical DK circuit simulation of the Alembic F-2B tone stack and volume, differing only by a fixed -26 dB output scale. Linear filter only, no tube stages.

gx-gx-studiopre.name: Alembic F-2B Studio Preamp
gx-gx-studiopre.shortDesc: Full Alembic F-2B: two 12AX7 sections, Bright/Normal, tone stack and master.
gx-gx-studiopre.description: DK circuit simulation from the schematic of the Alembic F-2B studio preamp (two 12AX7 sections with a Fender-style tone stack), with Bright and Normal channel clip tables, an output stage table and a five-band split. A clean, warm tube preamp with Bass/Middle/Treble, Volume and Master.

gx-gxmetal-amp.name: Metal Amp: 12AY7 pre → EL34 push-pull
gx-gxmetal-amp.shortDesc: High-gain head: 12AY7 preamp stages, tone control and an EL34 push-pull power stage.
gx-gxmetal-amp.description: Three 12AY7 triode stages through tube tables feed a tone control and a push-pull EL34 power stage modelled with the plate-loaded tubestageP table, driven by a distortion block. Pregain, Gain and Tone shape a saturated hi-gain voice.

gx-gxmetal-head.name: Metal Head: 12AX7 pre → 6L6 push-pull
gx-gxmetal-head.shortDesc: High-gain 12AX7 head into a 6L6GC push-pull power stage; tight modern distortion.
gx-gxmetal-head.description: Three 12AX7 triode stages through tube tables feed a paralleled 6L6GC push-pull power stage modelled with the plate-loaded tubestageP table, driven by a distortion block. Pregain and Gain stack up gain for a tight, saturated metal head.

gx-gx-ampmodul.name: Post-Amp Tube Stage (6V6)
gx-gx-ampmodul.shortDesc: 6V6 tube-table stages with adjustable feedback and wet/dry; a tube 'power amp' post block.
gx-gx-ampmodul.description: Runs the signal through two 6V6 tube-table stages (Tube1 and Tube2 gains) inside two adjustable feedback loops, with a wet/dry balance. Designed as a post-amp block for adding power-stage grit and compression after a preamp.

gx-preamp.name: Polynomial Preamp
gx-preamp.shortDesc: Simple polynomial-waveshaper preamp with atan normalisation; soft drive.
gx-preamp.description: Two cascaded low-order polynomial nonlinearities with a 3-sample moving-average filter on each side and an atan-normalised output; the drive control sets how hard the atan stage is hit. A simple soft-drive preamp, not a circuit model.

gx-gx-bigchump.name: Redeye Big Chump
gx-gx-bigchump.shortDesc: Redeye Big Chump small tube amp: two DK preamp stages into a power stage.
gx-gx-bigchump.description: DK circuit simulation from the Redeye Chump schematics: two preamp stages and a power stage from the redeye library, each a pot-dependent filter followed by a clip table, run in a five-band split. Small-amp tube warmth with Gain and Tone; the feedback switch is noted in the source as not yet working.

gx-gx-chump.name: Redeye Chump
gx-gx-chump.shortDesc: Redeye Chump small tube amp with selectable power-amp feedback; sweet low-watt breakup.
gx-gx-chump.description: DK circuit simulation from the Redeye Chump schematic: a preamp stage with Gain and Tone into a power stage, each a pot-dependent filter followed by a clip table, with a switch between feedback and no-feedback power-amp models. Low-wattage tube breakup that stays touch sensitive.

gx-gx-vibrochump.name: Redeye Vibro Chump
gx-gx-vibrochump.shortDesc: Redeye Chump amp with vactrol tremolo and a presence-style power-stage feedback loop.
gx-gx-vibrochump.description: DK circuit simulation of the Redeye Chump preamp and power stage, with a feedback loop around the power tube that acts as a presence control and a built-in vactrol (LDR) tremolo with Speed and Intensity. A small tube amp with amp-style tremolo.

gx-reso-tube.name: Resonant Tube
gx-reso-tube.shortDesc: Tube-style clipper feeding a short resonant delay; fuzzy, ringing overtones.
gx-reso-tube.description: A polynomial tube-style nonlinearity into a short feedback comb resonator (Vibrato sets the delay, Resonance the feedback) with symmetric clipping, mixed with the dry signal. Adds ringing, resonant harmonics rather than modelling a specific circuit.

gx-tube.name: Fuzzy Tube
gx-tube.shortDesc: Single 'fuzzy tube' polynomial waveshaper; simple, gritty tube-ish drive.
gx-tube.description: One stage of guitarix's fuzzy_tube polynomial waveshaper with fixed curve parameters; the Fuzzy control sets the amount. A simple gritty drive, not a circuit model.

gx-tube3.name: Valve Stage (Bendiksen ×2, gain)
gx-tube3.shortDesc: Two Bendiksen triode-model stages with gain, Q and dist controls; ported from swh Valve.
gx-tube3.description: Two inverting passes through the Bendiksen valve model from Steve Harris's swh-plugins Valve, with an inter-stage gain control. Dist sets distortion amount and Q the asymmetry, giving a soft triode-style saturation.

gx-valve.name: Valve Stage (Bendiksen ×2)
gx-valve.shortDesc: Two Bendiksen triode-model stages back to back; soft valve saturation.
gx-valve.description: Two inverting passes through the Bendiksen valve model from Steve Harris's swh-plugins Valve. Dist controls the distortion amount and Q the bias/asymmetry, giving a soft, even-harmonic valve saturation.

gx-gx-w20.name: Westbury W-20
gx-gx-w20.shortDesc: Westbury W-20 12AX7 preamp with Gain and Level; clean-to-crunch tube preamp.
gx-gx-w20.description: DK circuit simulation from the schematic of the Westbury W-20 preamp: two 12AX7 stages as pot-dependent filters with clip tables, run in a five-band split. A straightforward Gain/Level tube preamp for clean to crunchy tones.

gx-axface.name: Ax Face
gx-axface.shortDesc: Fuzz Face-style transistor fuzz with Attack, Smooth and Level.
gx-axface.description: DK circuit simulation from the schematic of the Ax Face fuzz: a pot-dependent state-space filter followed by two transistor-stage tables. Attack sets the fuzz amount and Smooth softens the edge for a vintage two-transistor fuzz.

gx-bfuzz.name: Bass Fuzz
gx-bfuzz.shortDesc: Bass fuzz pedal with Drive, Thickness and wet/dry blend to keep the low end.
gx-bfuzz.description: DK circuit simulation from the schematic of a bass fuzz pedal with a transistor clipper stage, plus a wet/dry control so the clean low end can be blended back in. Thickness shapes the body of the fuzz.

gx-bigmuff.name: Big Muff Tone Stage
gx-bigmuff.shortDesc: Only the Big Muff Pi tone control: low-pass and high-pass blended by one knob.
gx-bigmuff.description: Models just the Big Muff Pi passive tone stack as a 408 Hz low-pass and a 1.86 kHz high-pass mixed by the Tone knob. No distortion; the source notes it lacks the real unit's 1 kHz dip.

gx-bmfp.name: Big Muff Fuzz (polynomial)
gx-bmfp.shortDesc: Old hand-written Big Muff-style fuzz using polynomial waveshapers and a tone control.
gx-bmfp.description: An early hand-written Big Muff-style fuzz: cascaded polynomial waveshapers with Drive, followed by a tone control and output level. Not a circuit model; the newer Big Muff Pi entry is the accurate one.

gx-bmp.name: Big Muff Pi
gx-bmp.shortDesc: Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi: thick, sustaining four-transistor fuzz; Sustain and Tone.
gx-bmp.description: DK circuit simulation from the Big Muff Pi schematic: pot-dependent state-space filters with a symmetric diode clip stage, at 96 kHz. Sustain drives the clipping stages for the Big Muff's wall of thick, singing fuzz; Tone scoops between bass and treble.

gx-bossds1.name: Boss DS-1
gx-bossds1.shortDesc: Boss DS-1 Distortion: transistor boost into an op-amp hard clipper with the DS-1 tone.
gx-bossds1.description: DK circuit simulation from the Boss DS-1 schematic: input buffer, transistor gain stage, op-amp asymmetric hard-clipping stage and the DS-1 active tone control as pot-dependent filters, at 96 kHz. Tight, buzzy rock distortion with Tone, Drive and Level.

gx-buffb.name: Transistor Buffer Boost
gx-buffb.shortDesc: Single-transistor buffer/booster; clean level lift with a slight tonal change.
gx-buffb.description: DK circuit simulation from the transistor buffer schematic: a linear pot-dependent filter for Volume and Intensity. A clean boost with the mild colouring of a discrete transistor buffer.

gx-buzz.name: Buzz Box
gx-buzz.shortDesc: Baldwin-Burns Buzzaround-style transistor fuzz with a wet/dry blend.
gx-buzz.description: DK circuit simulation from the schematic of a Buzzaround-style fuzz box with a transistor clipper stage and a wet/dry blend. A raspy, sputtery 1960s fuzz with Level.

gx-coverd.name: Colorsound Overdriver
gx-coverd.shortDesc: Colorsound Overdriver: transistor booster/overdrive with Bass and Treble.
gx-coverd.description: DK circuit simulation from the schematic of the Colorsound Overdriver as a pot-dependent linear filter (Volume, Bass, Treble) with a wet/dry blend. In this port it acts as a coloured booster with the Overdriver's tone controls.

gx-drive.name: Fuzzy Tube Drive
gx-drive.shortDesc: Fuzzy-tube polynomial waveshaper with a hotter curve than the Tube stage; gritty drive.
gx-drive.description: One pass through guitarix's fuzzy_tube polynomial waveshaper with a more aggressive fixed curve than the Tube stage; Drive sets the amount. A simple, gritty drive rather than a circuit model.

gx-eldist.name: Electra Distortion
gx-eldist.shortDesc: Electra one-transistor distortion: single gain stage with asymmetric diode clipping.
gx-eldist.description: DK circuit simulation from the schematic of the Electra distortion circuit: a transistor gain stage as a pot-dependent filter with an asymmetric clip table, at 96 kHz. A raw, touch-sensitive single-knob (Drive) distortion.

gx-ffreak.name: Fat Furry Freak
gx-ffreak.shortDesc: Extreme bass fuzz with Fuzz, Tone, Gate and Level; huge and gated.
gx-ffreak.description: DK circuit simulation from the Fat Freak schematic: pot-dependent filters with clipping stages and an atan-shaped gate. An over-the-top bass fuzz whose Gate control chokes the decay for sputtery, velcro-style textures.

gx-foxeylady.name: Foxey Lady
gx-foxeylady.shortDesc: Guild Foxey Lady (Tone Bender-style) three-transistor fuzz with Fuzz and Level.
gx-foxeylady.description: DK circuit simulation from the Foxey Lady schematic: pot-dependent state-space filters followed by three transistor-stage tables. A thick, saturated three-transistor fuzz in the Tone Bender family.

gx-fuzzface.name: Fuzz Face (JH-1)
gx-fuzzface.shortDesc: Dallas Arbiter Fuzz Face (JH-1): warm two-transistor fuzz that cleans up with volume.
gx-fuzzface.description: DK circuit simulation from the Fuzz Face JH-1 schematic: a 5th-order state-space filter whose coefficients follow the Fuzz and Level pots, followed by transistor-stage tables. Classic Hendrix-style fuzz with Fuzz and Level.

gx-fuzzfacefm.name: Fuzz Face (Fuller Mods)
gx-fuzzfacefm.shortDesc: Fuzz Face with Mike Fuller's mods, adding a Drive control for finer gain range.
gx-fuzzfacefm.description: DK circuit simulation from the Fuzz Face Fuller-mods schematic: pot-dependent state-space filters with transistor-stage tables, with an added Drive control. A more controllable Fuzz Face with Fuzz, Drive and Level.

gx-fuzzfacerm.name: Fuzz Face (Roger Mayer)
gx-fuzzfacerm.shortDesc: Roger Mayer's Fuzz Face variant; smoother, more refined fuzz with Fuzz and Level.
gx-fuzzfacerm.description: DK circuit simulation from the Roger Mayer Fuzz Face schematic: pot-dependent state-space filters followed by two transistor-stage tables. A smoother, more polished take on the Fuzz Face circuit.

gx-fumaster.name: Vintage Fuzz Master
gx-fumaster.shortDesc: Vintage Fuzz Master three-transistor fuzz with Tone, Volume and a wet/dry blend.
gx-fumaster.description: DK circuit simulation from the Vintage Fuzz Master schematic: pot-dependent filters followed by three transistor-stage tables, plus a wet/dry blend. A gnarly 1960s-style fuzz with a Tone control.

gx-hogsfoot.name: Hogs Foot Bass Booster
gx-hogsfoot.shortDesc: Electro-Harmonix Hog's Foot bass booster; low-end lift with a wet/dry blend.
gx-hogsfoot.description: DK circuit simulation from the Hog's Foot schematic as a pot-dependent linear filter with Volume and a wet/dry blend. A simple transistor bass booster for adding weight to the low end.

gx-hornet.name: Hornet
gx-hornet.shortDesc: Electro-Harmonix Hornet-style fuzz with Volume, Sustain and Fuzz.
gx-hornet.description: DK circuit simulation from the Hornet schematic: pot-dependent filters with clipping stages. A compact, sustaining fuzz with separate Sustain and Fuzz controls.

gx-lpbboost.name: LPB-1 Linear Power Booster
gx-lpbboost.shortDesc: Electro-Harmonix LPB-1 one-transistor clean boost with a single Boost knob.
gx-lpbboost.description: DK circuit simulation from the LPB-1 schematic as a pot-dependent linear filter. A near-transparent single-transistor boost for pushing an amp harder.

gx-muff.name: Muff (transistor-stage Big Muff)
gx-muff.shortDesc: Big Muff-style fuzz built from three transistor-stage tables with a Tone control.
gx-muff.description: DK circuit simulation from the Muff schematic: pot-dependent filters followed by three transistor-stage tables and the Muff tone control. A variant Big Muff model that uses the transistor library rather than diode clip tables.

gx-gx-distortion.name: Multi-Band Distortion (guitarix)
gx-gx-distortion.shortDesc: Guitarix's original four-band distortion with per-band drive/gain, resonator and wet/dry.
gx-gx-distortion.description: Splits the signal at three adjustable crossover frequencies and applies separate drive and gain per band, with an optional resonator and a wet/dry blend. The original guitarix distortion block; an algorithmic design rather than a pedal model.

gx-mbclipper.name: Multi-Band Clipper
gx-mbclipper.shortDesc: Five-band clipper with independent Drive and Gain per band.
gx-mbclipper.description: Splits the input into five bands at four adjustable crossovers and hard-clips each band with its own Drive and Gain. Useful for controlled, band-limited distortion without low-end mud.

gx-mbd.name: Multi-Band Distortion
gx-mbd.shortDesc: Five-band distortion with per-band Drive and DC Offset for asymmetric clipping.
gx-mbd.description: Splits the input into five bands at four adjustable crossovers and distorts each with its own Drive and Offset (bias for asymmetry), then a master Gain. Lets bass stay clean while highs saturate.

gx-mxrdist.name: MXR Distortion+
gx-mxrdist.shortDesc: MXR Distortion+: op-amp gain into germanium-style diode clipping; crunchy, mid-forward.
gx-mxrdist.description: Hand-written model of the MXR Distortion+ with input and output filters as pot-dependent filters and a diode clipper approximation, at 96 kHz. Drive and Volume give the classic crunchy, slightly nasal 1970s distortion.

gx-overdrive.name: Overdrive (rational waveshaper)
gx-overdrive.shortDesc: Simple rational-function overdrive with drive-compensated level and wet/dry.
gx-overdrive.description: A single rational waveshaper x(|x|+d)/(x²+(d-1)|x|+1) with automatic level compensation and a wet/dry blend. Smooth, generic overdrive; not a circuit model.

gx-rangem.name: Dallas Rangemaster
gx-rangem.shortDesc: Dallas Rangemaster germanium treble booster; cuts lows and drives an amp's front end.
gx-rangem.description: DK circuit simulation from the Rangemaster schematic as a pot-dependent linear filter with a wet/dry blend. Boost adds the Rangemaster's bright, bass-shy push that sharpens an overdriven amp.

gx-aclipper.name: ProCo RAT
gx-aclipper.shortDesc: ProCo RAT-style op-amp distortion with asymmetric hard clipping, tone and level.
gx-aclipper.description: Op-amp gain-stage model into an asymmetric hard-clip table with a tone low-pass and level, at 96 kHz. Delivers the RAT's aggressive, saturated crunch from Drive, Tone and Level.

gx-ruin.name: Devi Ever Ruiner
gx-ruin.shortDesc: Devi Ever Ruiner / Dark Boost: nasty, splattery fuzz with Intensity and Level.
gx-ruin.description: DK circuit simulation from the Ruiner schematic: pot-dependent filters with a symmetric clip table, at 96 kHz. Intensity pushes it from a dark boost into an unhinged, splattery fuzz.

gx-scream.name: Screaming Bird
gx-scream.shortDesc: Electro-Harmonix Screaming Bird treble booster; bright single-transistor boost.
gx-scream.description: DK circuit simulation from the Screaming Bird schematic: a transistor stage as a pot-dependent filter with clipping. The Scream knob adds a piercing, bass-cut treble boost.

gx-softclip.name: Soft Clip
gx-softclip.shortDesc: Symmetric soft clipper with a residual blend; gentle, generic saturation.
gx-softclip.description: Symmetric clipping at a threshold set by the Fuzz control, with a third of the clipped-off residual mixed back in. A basic saturation stage rather than a pedal model.

gx-mole.name: EHX Mole Bass Booster
gx-mole.shortDesc: Electro-Harmonix Mole bass booster; single-knob low-end boost with wet/dry.
gx-mole.description: DK circuit simulation from the Mole schematic as a pot-dependent linear filter with a wet/dry blend. Boost lifts the low end for a fatter tone.

gx-ts9sim.name: Ibanez TS9 Tube Screamer
gx-ts9sim.shortDesc: Ibanez TS-9 Tube Screamer: mid-hump op-amp overdrive with Drive, Tone, Level.
gx-ts9sim.description: Circuit model of the Ibanez TS-9 from the schematic (Kenéz analysis): the clipping stage's bilinear filter from the real R/C values with a Newton-solved diode nonlinearity via a C foreign function, then the tone low-pass and level, at 96 kHz. The classic smooth, mid-forward overdrive.

gx-compressor.name: Compressor
gx-compressor.shortDesc: Albert Graef's compressor/limiter with ratio, threshold, knee, attack and release.
gx-compressor.description: Feed-forward compressor with an envelope detector and a soft knee; Ratio, Threshold, Knee, Attack and Release. A clean, general-purpose compressor for evening out picking dynamics.

gx-expander.name: Expander
gx-expander.shortDesc: Downward expander that attenuates signals below the threshold; gentle noise reduction.
gx-expander.description: The compressor in reverse: applies Ratio to attenuate levels below Threshold with a soft Knee, Attack and Release. Use it as a subtle gate to tame hum and hiss between phrases.

gx-mbc.name: Multi-Band Compressor
gx-mbc.shortDesc: Five-band compressor with per-band ratio, threshold, makeup, attack, release and mode.
gx-mbc.description: Splits the signal at four adjustable crossovers and compresses each band independently with Ratio, Makeup, Threshold, Attack, Release and a per-band Mode. Controls dynamics per frequency range without pumping the whole signal.

gx-mbcs.name: Multi-Band Compressor (stereo)
gx-mbcs.shortDesc: Stereo version of the five-band compressor with linked per-band controls.
gx-mbcs.description: Stereo build of the five-band compressor: four adjustable crossovers, per-band Ratio, Makeup, Threshold, Attack, Release and Mode. Same processing as the mono version but with a stereo detector path.

gx-susta.name: Sustainer
gx-susta.shortDesc: Transistor sustainer/compressor pedal circuit; squashy, long sustain with a fuzzy edge.
gx-susta.description: DK circuit simulation from the Sustainer schematic: pot-dependent filters followed by three transistor-stage tables. Sustain and Volume give a squashed, compressor-like sustain that breaks into light fuzz when pushed.

gx-tonecontroll.name: 3-Band Tone Control
gx-tonecontroll.shortDesc: Three-band crossover EQ with Bass/Middle/Treble gains and a 'sharper' compression stage.
gx-tonecontroll.description: Splits the signal into bass, mid and treble bands with a filterbank at 600 Hz and 2.4 kHz, applies per-band gain, then a compressor whose Sharper control tightens the result. A simple active three-band tone shaper.

gx-tonestack-ac15.name: Tone Stack — Vox AC15
gx-tonestack-ac15.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with the Vox AC15's component values.
gx-tonestack-ac15.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the classic passive amp tone stack (after Yeh / CAPS), with R and C values from the Vox AC15. Bass, Middle and Treble interact the way they do on the real amp.

gx-tonestack-ac30.name: Tone Stack — Vox AC30
gx-tonestack-ac30.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Vox AC30 component values.
gx-tonestack-ac30.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Vox AC30 ('59/'86). Interactive Bass, Middle and Treble with the AC30's chimey top end.

gx-tonestack-ampeg.name: Tone Stack — Ampeg VL-501
gx-tonestack-ampeg.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Ampeg VL-501 component values.
gx-tonestack-ampeg.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Ampeg VL-501. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-astrofuzz.name: Astrotone Fuzz
gx-astrofuzz.shortDesc: Sam Ash Astrotone-style two-transistor fuzz with Tone, Volume and Attack.
gx-astrofuzz.description: DK circuit simulation from the Astrotone schematic: pot-dependent filters followed by two transistor-stage tables. A smooth, vintage two-transistor fuzz where Attack sets the fuzz amount and Tone tilts the voicing.

gx-bassboom.name: Bass Boom
gx-bassboom.shortDesc: Sub-bass enhancer that generates harmonics from the band below 110 Hz.
gx-bassboom.description: Splits off the band below 110 Hz, runs it through a distortion stage to generate sub-bass harmonics (Drive), and mixes it back in with the rest of the signal (Gain). Adds weight and audibility to bass rather than colouring the whole signal.

gx-bassbooster.name: Bass Booster
gx-bassbooster.shortDesc: Second-order low shelf boost at 120 Hz with a single Level control.
gx-bassbooster.description: A DAFX-style second-order low-shelving filter fixed at 120 Hz; Level sets the boost in dB. A clean low-end lift with no distortion.

gx-tonestack-bassman.name: Tone Stack — Fender Bassman
gx-tonestack-bassman.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with '59 Bassman 5F6-A values; the archetypal stack.
gx-tonestack-bassman.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the 1959 Fender Bassman 5F6-A. The stack most tweed and Marshall circuits descend from; interactive Bass, Middle and Treble.

gx-cabinet-impulse-former.name: Cabinet Impulse Former
gx-cabinet-impulse-former.shortDesc: Bass/treble shelving and level shaper meant to sit after a cabinet impulse.
gx-cabinet-impulse-former.description: A bass and treble shelving tone control with a Level trim, designed in guitarix to re-shape the response of a convolution cabinet. On its own it is a simple two-band shelf EQ.

gx-cstb.name: Colorsound Tone Bender
gx-cstb.shortDesc: Colorsound Tone Bender two-transistor fuzz with Attack, Level and wet/dry.
gx-cstb.description: DK circuit simulation from the Colorsound Tone Bender schematic: pot-dependent filters followed by two transistor-stage tables, with a wet/dry blend. Attack sets the fuzz for a raw, sustaining British fuzz.

gx-tonestack-default.name: Tone Stack — Default (shelving)
gx-tonestack-default.shortDesc: Guitarix's 'default' tone stack: Bass/Middle/Treble mapped onto shelving/peak filters.
gx-tonestack-default.description: Not a passive stack model: maps the Bass, Middle and Treble knobs onto low-shelf, mid-peak and high-shelf filters from the Tone module. A neutral, non-interactive three-band EQ.

gx-tonestack-fender-deville.name: Tone Stack — Fender Hot Rod DeVille
gx-tonestack-fender-deville.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Fender Hot Rod DeVille values.
gx-tonestack-fender-deville.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Fender Hot Rod DeVille. Interactive three-band tone control with a modern Fender voicing.

gx-tonestack-engl.name: Tone Stack — Engl
gx-tonestack-engl.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Engl component values.
gx-tonestack-engl.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from an Engl amplifier. Interactive three-band tone control with a tight, modern voicing.

gx-eq.name: 10-Band Parametric EQ
gx-eq.shortDesc: Ten octave-spaced peaking filters (31 Hz–16 kHz) with per-band gain and Q.
gx-eq.description: Ten cascaded peaking filters at octave centres from 31.25 Hz to 16 kHz, each with its own gain (-50 to +10 dB) and Q. A graphic-style EQ with adjustable bandwidth per band.

gx-tonestack-fender-default.name: Tone Stack — Fender
gx-tonestack-fender-default.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with generic Fender blackface values.
gx-tonestack-fender-default.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with typical Fender blackface R and C values. Interactive Bass, Middle and Treble with the scooped Fender character.

gx-tonestack-gibsen.name: Tone Stack — Gibson GS-12 Reverb Rocket
gx-tonestack-gibsen.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Gibson GS-12 Reverb Rocket values.
gx-tonestack-gibsen.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Gibson GS-12 Reverb Rocket. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-graphiceq.name: 11-Band Graphic EQ
gx-graphiceq.shortDesc: Eleven-band graphic equaliser with slider gains from sub-bass to air.
gx-graphiceq.description: A filterbank graphic EQ with eleven fixed bands and a gain slider per band. Straightforward broad tone shaping.

gx-hfb.name: HF Brightener
gx-hfb.shortDesc: Transistor high-frequency brightener with Volume and Intensity.
gx-hfb.description: DK circuit simulation from the High Frequency Brightener schematic as a pot-dependent linear filter. Intensity adds sparkle and presence without distortion.

gx-tonestack-crunch.name: Tone Stack — Hughes & Kettner
gx-tonestack-crunch.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Hughes & Kettner crunch-channel values.
gx-tonestack-crunch.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from a Hughes & Kettner crunch channel. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-tonestack-ibanez.name: Tone Stack — Ibanez GX20
gx-tonestack-ibanez.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Ibanez GX20 values.
gx-tonestack-ibanez.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Ibanez GX20. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-tonestack-jcm2000.name: Tone Stack — Marshall JCM2000
gx-tonestack-jcm2000.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Marshall JCM2000 lead-channel values.
gx-tonestack-jcm2000.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Marshall JCM2000 lead channel. Interactive three-band tone control with a modern Marshall voicing.

gx-tonestack-jcm800.name: Tone Stack — Marshall JCM800
gx-tonestack-jcm800.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Marshall JCM800 2203 values.
gx-tonestack-jcm800.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Marshall JCM800 Lead 100 (2203). Interactive three-band tone control with the classic Marshall mid push.

gx-tonestack-jtm45.name: Tone Stack — Marshall JTM45
gx-tonestack-jtm45.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Marshall JTM45 values.
gx-tonestack-jtm45.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Marshall JTM45. Interactive three-band tone control, close to the Bassman it was copied from.

gx-low-high-pass.name: Low/High Pass Filter
gx-low-high-pass.shortDesc: Adjustable low-cut and high-cut filters plus band-limiting speaker-style pass filters.
gx-low-high-pass.description: A pair of adjustable high-pass and low-pass filters (low freq / high freq) followed by fixed band-limiting filters used in guitarix for speaker emulation. Trims rumble and fizz from a signal chain.

gx-tonestack-mlead.name: Tone Stack — Marshall Major Lead
gx-tonestack-mlead.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with '67 Marshall Major Lead 200 values.
gx-tonestack-mlead.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the 1967 Marshall Major Lead 200. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-tonestack-m2199.name: Tone Stack — Marshall M2199
gx-tonestack-m2199.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Marshall M2199 solid-state values.
gx-tonestack-m2199.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Marshall M2199 30 W solid-state amp. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-tonestack-mesa.name: Tone Stack — Mesa Boogie Mark
gx-tonestack-mesa.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Mesa Boogie Mark values.
gx-tonestack-mesa.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Mesa Boogie Mark series. Interactive three-band tone control with the Boogie's mid focus.

gx-tonestack-sovtek.name: Tone Stack — Sovtek MIG 100H
gx-tonestack-sovtek.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Sovtek MIG 100H values.
gx-tonestack-sovtek.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Sovtek MIG 100H. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-tonestack-peavey.name: Tone Stack — Peavey C20
gx-tonestack-peavey.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Peavey C20 values.
gx-tonestack-peavey.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Peavey C20. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-preamp-impulse-former.name: Preamp Impulse Former
gx-preamp-impulse-former.shortDesc: Bass/treble shelving and level trim meant to sit after a preamp impulse.
gx-preamp-impulse-former.description: A bass and treble shelving tone control with a finer Level trim, designed in guitarix to re-shape a convolution preamp response. On its own it is a simple two-band shelf EQ.

gx-presence-level.name: Presence Level
gx-presence-level.shortDesc: Single-knob gain trim (flagged FIXME upstream); no frequency shaping.
gx-presence-level.description: Applies a gain of Level × 10^(-0.1·Level), a plain level trim despite the name; the source marks it FIXME. No presence filtering is performed.

gx-tonestack-princeton.name: Tone Stack — Fender Princeton
gx-tonestack-princeton.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with '64 Fender Princeton AA1164 values.
gx-tonestack-princeton.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the 1964 Fender Princeton AA1164. Interactive three-band tone control with a small-Fender voicing.

gx-tonestack-ampeg-rev.name: Tone Stack — Ampeg Reverberocket
gx-tonestack-ampeg-rev.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Ampeg Reverberocket values.
gx-tonestack-ampeg-rev.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Ampeg Reverberocket. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-tonestack-roland.name: Tone Stack — Roland Cube 60
gx-tonestack-roland.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Roland Cube 60 values.
gx-tonestack-roland.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Roland Cube 60. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-selecteq.name: 10-Band Scalable EQ
gx-selecteq.shortDesc: Ten fully parametric peaking bands with adjustable centre frequency, gain and Q.
gx-selecteq.description: Ten cascaded peaking filters, each with adjustable centre frequency (20 Hz–20 kHz), gain (-50 to +10 dB) and Q. The parametric sibling of the 10-band EQ.

gx-tonestack-soldano.name: Tone Stack — Soldano SLO-100
gx-tonestack-soldano.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Soldano SLO-100 values.
gx-tonestack-soldano.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Soldano SLO-100. Interactive three-band tone control with a tight hi-gain voicing.

gx-gxtilttone.name: Tilt Tone Pro
gx-gxtilttone.shortDesc: Tilt-style tone control with Body and Drive and a soft clip stage; EQ with a little grit.
gx-gxtilttone.description: DK circuit simulation from the tilt-tone schematic: a 4th-order pot-dependent filter (Body, Tone, Drive) with input and output clip tables and a Level stage. Tone tilts the spectrum, lifting highs while cutting lows or vice versa, with mild saturation from Drive.

gx-tone.name: Tone (Bass/Mid/Treble shelves)
gx-tone.shortDesc: Three-band shelving/peak tone control from the RBJ Audio EQ Cookbook, ±20 dB.
gx-tone.description: Low shelf, mid peak and high shelf filters at fixed frequencies (RBJ Audio EQ Cookbook) with Bass, Middle and Treble gains of ±20 dB. A clean, non-interactive three-band tone control.

gx-tonestack.name: Tone Stack — Bassman (base module)
gx-tonestack.shortDesc: The tone-stack base module fixed to Bassman 5F6-A values; same as the Bassman entry.
gx-tonestack.description: The shared passive tone-stack component (symbolic third-order transfer function) with its selector hard-set to the 1959 Fender Bassman 5F6-A values. Functionally identical to the Fender Bassman tone stack.

gx-tonestack-bm.name: Tone Stack — Bassman (single Tone knob)
gx-tonestack-bm.shortDesc: Bassman passive tone stack driven by one Tone knob that moves all three bands.
gx-tonestack-bm.description: The Bassman 5F6-A passive tone stack model with a single Tone control linked to Bass, Middle and Treble at once. A one-knob variant for simple pedal layouts.

gx-highbooster.name: Treble Boost
gx-highbooster.shortDesc: First-order high-pass boost above 1.5 kHz, 0–20 dB.
gx-highbooster.description: Adds a first-order high-passed copy of the signal above 1.5 kHz scaled by Level (0–20 dB). A clean, simple treble lift.

gx-tonestack-groove.name: Tone Stack — Groove Tubes Trio Preamp
gx-tonestack-groove.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Trio Preamp values.
gx-tonestack-groove.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Trio Preamp. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-tonestack-bogner.name: Tone Stack — Bogner Triple Giant
gx-tonestack-bogner.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Bogner Triple Giant preamp values.
gx-tonestack-bogner.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Bogner Triple Giant preamp. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-autowah.name: Auto Wah (Cry Baby)
gx-autowah.shortDesc: Envelope-following auto-wah built on the Cry Baby biquad fit; touch-controlled quack.
gx-autowah.description: Uses the Cry Baby wah biquad approximation (Julius Smith's fit of the Dunlop circuit) swept by an envelope follower instead of a pedal, with Wah range, Level and wet/dry. Picking dynamics open and close the filter.

gx-colwah.name: Colorsound Wah
gx-colwah.shortDesc: Colorsound inductorless wah with Wah position, frequency, mode and wet/dry.
gx-colwah.description: DK circuit simulation from the Colorsound Wah schematic as a pot-dependent filter with a mode switch and wet/dry. A vocal, mid-forward British wah.

gx-dallaswah.name: Dallas Arbiter Wah
gx-dallaswah.shortDesc: Dallas Arbiter wah pedal with Wah position, frequency, mode and wet/dry.
gx-dallaswah.description: DK circuit simulation from the Dallas Wah schematic as a pot-dependent filter with a mode switch and wet/dry. A 1960s-style wah with a throaty sweep.

gx-dunwah.name: Dunlop Wah (fitted)
gx-dunwah.shortDesc: Dunlop-style wah as two biquads fitted to the circuit response; one Wah control.
gx-dunwah.description: Two cascaded biquads whose coefficients were fitted to the Dunlop wah circuit response by guitarix's dunwah scripts, swept by a single Wah control. A lightweight wah model.

gx-foxwah.name: Foxx Wah
gx-foxwah.shortDesc: Foxx wah pedal with Wah position, frequency, mode and wet/dry.
gx-foxwah.description: DK circuit simulation from the Foxx Wah schematic as a pot-dependent filter with a mode switch and wet/dry. A wide, fuzzy-era wah sweep.

gx-gcb-95.name: Dunlop GCB-95 Cry Baby
gx-gcb-95.shortDesc: Full linear model of the Dunlop GCB-95 Cry Baby circuit with a hot-potz sweep.
gx-gcb-95.description: Linear circuit simulation of the GCB-95 Cry Baby (inductor plus transistor stages) as a 4th-order filter whose coefficients follow the pedal pot, generated from the schematic. Hotpotz sets the sweep position and Volume the output.

gx-jenwah.name: Jen Wah
gx-jenwah.shortDesc: Jen Cry Baby wah with Wah position, frequency, mode and wet/dry.
gx-jenwah.description: DK circuit simulation from the Jen Wah schematic as a pot-dependent filter with a mode switch and wet/dry. The Italian-made Cry Baby voice.

gx-maestrowah.name: Maestro Boomerang Wah
gx-maestrowah.shortDesc: Maestro Boomerang EG-1 wah with Wah position, frequency, mode and wet/dry.
gx-maestrowah.description: DK circuit simulation from the Maestro Boomerang schematic as a pot-dependent filter with a mode switch and wet/dry. A deep, vocal wah sweep.

gx-crybaby.name: Cry Baby Wah (manual)
gx-crybaby.shortDesc: Manual Cry Baby wah from the JOS biquad fit, with Wah, Level and wet/dry.
gx-crybaby.description: Julius Smith's biquad approximation of the Dunlop Cry Baby wah, swept manually by the Wah control, with Level and wet/dry. A light, reliable wah for expression-pedal control.

gx-moog.name: Moog Ladder Filter
gx-moog.shortDesc: Moog-style ladder low-pass with cutoff and resonance.
gx-moog.description: A Moog ladder low-pass filter (moogvcf) with Q (resonance) and cutoff frequency controls. Synth-style filtering for guitar.

gx-multifilter.name: 10-Band Multi Filter
gx-multifilter.shortDesc: Ten octave-spaced peaking filters with per-band gain and Q; same as the 10-Band EQ.
gx-multifilter.description: Ten cascaded peaking filters at octave centres from 31.25 Hz to 16 kHz with per-band gain and Q. Identical processing to the 10-Band Parametric EQ.

gx-rolandwah.name: Roland Double Beat
gx-rolandwah.shortDesc: Roland AW-10 Double Beat fuzz-wah with an LFO-driven wah and transistor fuzz.
gx-rolandwah.description: DK circuit simulation from the Roland Wah schematic combined with a transistor fuzz stage (two transistor-stage tables); the wah is swept by an LFO set in BPM. Fuzz, Wah and wet/dry recreate the Double Beat's fuzz-wah combo.

gx-selwah.name: Selmer Wah
gx-selwah.shortDesc: Selmer wah pedal with Wah position, frequency, mode and wet/dry.
gx-selwah.description: DK circuit simulation from the Selmer Wah schematic as a pot-dependent filter with a mode switch and wet/dry. A British 1960s wah voice.

gx-voxwah.name: Vox V847 Wah
gx-voxwah.shortDesc: Vox V847 wah with Wah position, frequency, mode and wet/dry.
gx-voxwah.description: DK circuit simulation from the Vox V847 schematic as a pot-dependent filter with a mode switch and wet/dry. The classic Vox wah sweep.

gx-chorus.name: Chorus
gx-chorus.shortDesc: Albert Graef's chorus with level, rate, delay and depth; summed to mono here.
gx-chorus.description: Table-LFO modulated delay-line chorus with Level, Freq, Delay and Depth; originally stereo with a per-channel phase offset, wrapped to mono for the pedal. A classic clean digital chorus.

gx-chorus-mono.name: Chorus Mono
gx-chorus-mono.shortDesc: Simplified mono chorus with level, rate and wet/dry.
gx-chorus-mono.description: Mono version of the Graef chorus with fixed delay and depth, exposing only Level, Freq and wet/dry. A quick, set-and-forget chorus.

gx-flanger.name: Flanger
gx-flanger.shortDesc: Faust library stereo flanger (delay, offset, rate, depth, feedback) summed to mono.
gx-flanger.description: Wrapper around the Faust library flanger with flange delay, delay offset, LFO rate, depth, feedback gain and level; originally stereo with sine/cosine LFOs, wrapped to mono for the pedal. A jet-like swept comb filter.

gx-flanger-gx.name: Flanger GX
gx-flanger-gx.shortDesc: Guitarix's hand-written mono flanger with width in ms, depth, rate, feedback, wet and mix.
gx-flanger-gx.description: A hand-written mono flanger with Width (ms), Depth, Freq, Feedback, Wet and Mix. Same code as the gx_flanger entry.

gx-gx-flanger.name: Flanger GX (LV2 copy)
gx-gx-flanger.shortDesc: Duplicate of Flanger GX from the LV2 source tree; identical processing.
gx-gx-flanger.description: The LV2 copy of guitarix's hand-written mono flanger with Width, Depth, Freq, Feedback, Wet and Mix. Identical to Flanger GX apart from a comment.

gx-flanger-mono.name: Flanger Mono
gx-flanger-mono.shortDesc: Simple mono flanger with rate, level and wet/dry.
gx-flanger-mono.description: Mono flanger built on the Faust library flanger with fixed delay settings, exposing Freq, Level and wet/dry. A quick one-knob-style flange.

gx-gxtubevibrato.name: Tube Vibrato
gx-gxtubevibrato.shortDesc: True pitch vibrato from a modulated delay, wrapped in 12AX7 tube stages, in five bands.
gx-gxtubevibrato.description: A delay-line pitch vibrato with Speed and Depth, whose LFO can be triangle or sine, run inside 12AX7 input and output tube-table stages across a five-band split. Drive sets the tube grit and Output the level.

gx-tonestack-fender-blues.name: Tone Stack — Fender Blues Junior
gx-tonestack-fender-blues.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with Fender Blues Junior values.
gx-tonestack-fender-blues.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the Fender Blues Junior. Interactive three-band tone control.

gx-mbchor.name: Multi-Band Chorus
gx-mbchor.shortDesc: Five-band chorus with independent level, rate, delay and depth per band.
gx-mbchor.description: Splits the signal at four adjustable crossovers and applies a separate chorus (Level, Freq, Delay, Depth) to each band. Lets the low end stay steady while the highs shimmer.

gx-uniBar.name: Banded Waveguide Bar Resonator
gx-uniBar.shortDesc: STK bowed-bar physical model (banded waveguides) added to the input; metallic ring.
gx-uniBar.description: Romain Michon's nonlinear banded-waveguide bar model from the STK: a bowed excitation feeding four modal delay-line resonators tuned by Synth Freq, summed with the input. Adds a ringing, bar-like resonance rather than processing the guitar directly.

gx-phaser.name: Phaser
gx-phaser.shortDesc: JOS phaser2: swept second-order allpass notches with speed, depth, feedback and spread.
gx-phaser.description: Julius Smith's phaser2 from the Faust effect library: a chain of second-order resonant allpasses swept by an LFO, with Speed, Depth, Feedback, Notch Width, min/max notch frequency and notch spread; wrapped to mono. A rich, adjustable analog-style phaser.

gx-phaser-mono.name: Phaser Mono
gx-phaser-mono.shortDesc: Simplified mono phaser with speed, level and wet/dry.
gx-phaser-mono.description: Mono phaser built on the JOS phaser2 with fixed depth, feedback and notch settings, exposing Speed, Level and wet/dry. A simple, classic phase sweep.

gx-switched-tremolo.name: Switched Tremolo
gx-switched-tremolo.shortDesc: Line 6 POD-style tremolo that steps between up to four LFO rates.
gx-switched-tremolo.description: Tremolo whose modulation cycles through up to four oscillator frequencies (Steps, Switch Freq, Freq 0–3) with Depth and wet/dry, inspired by the Line 6 POD. Produces rhythmic, pattern-like tremolo.

gx-tremolo.name: Vactrol Tremolo
gx-tremolo.shortDesc: Opto (vactrol/LDR) tremolo with CdS-cell lag; smooth amp-style throb.
gx-tremolo.description: Model of a vactrol tremolo by transmogrifox: a hysteretic triangle LFO drives a CdS photocell model with RC lag and a resistive divider. Freq, Depth and wet/dry give the smooth, slightly asymmetric pulse of an optical amp tremolo.

gx-gxtubetremelo.name: Tube Tremolo
gx-gxtubetremelo.shortDesc: Vactrol tremolo wrapped in 12AX7 input and output tube stages, in five bands.
gx-gxtubetremelo.description: The vactrol (LDR) tremolo model placed between 12AX7 input and output tube-table stages across a five-band split, with Drive for tube grit, Speed, Depth and Output. Amp-style tremolo with tube warmth.

gx-tubevibrato.name: Tube Vibrato (feedback)
gx-tubevibrato.shortDesc: One-sample feedback into a symmetric clipper; a resonant tone shaper, not a real vibrato.
gx-tubevibrato.description: Feeds the output back into the input by Vibrato/2 (one-sample loop) and clips symmetrically at 0.7. Despite the name this produces resonance and clipping rather than pitch modulation.

gx-freeverb.name: Freeverb
gx-freeverb.shortDesc: Schroeder/Moorer Freeverb with room size, damping and wet/dry.
gx-freeverb.description: The classic Freeverb algorithm (parallel combs into series allpasses) with RoomSize, Damp and wet/dry. A simple, smooth digital room reverb.

gx-mbreverb.name: Multi-Band Reverb
gx-mbreverb.shortDesc: Five-band Freeverb with independent room size, damping and wet/dry per band.
gx-mbreverb.description: Splits the signal at four adjustable crossovers and applies a separate Freeverb (RoomSize, Damp, wet/dry) to each band. Keeps the lows dry while the highs bloom.

gx-stereoverb.name: Stereo Verb
gx-stereoverb.shortDesc: Freeverb with an LFO-modulated stereo spread, summed to mono here.
gx-stereoverb.description: Freeverb (RoomSize, Damp, wet/dry) with an LFO that modulates the stereo image; wrapped to mono for the pedal, so the LFO adds subtle movement rather than width.

gx-tonestack-twin.name: Tone Stack — Fender Twin Reverb
gx-tonestack-twin.shortDesc: Passive Bass/Middle/Treble tone stack with '69 Fender Twin Reverb AA270 values.
gx-tonestack-twin.description: Symbolic third-order transfer function of the passive amp tone stack with R and C values from the 1969 Fender Twin Reverb AA270. Interactive three-band tone control with the blackface scoop.

gx-gx-zita-rev1.name: Zita Rev1 (LV2 copy)
gx-gx-zita-rev1.shortDesc: Duplicate of the Zita Rev1 reverb from the LV2 tree; same algorithm and controls.
gx-gx-zita-rev1.description: Fons Adriaensen's zita-rev1 feedback-delay-network reverb with pre-delay, low/mid RT60, crossover, HF damping, two-band EQ and mix; wrapped to mono. Identical processing to the other Zita Rev1 entry, differing only in control labels.

gx-zita-rev1.name: Zita Rev1
gx-zita-rev1.shortDesc: Fons Adriaensen's zita-rev1 FDN hall reverb with RT60 per band and built-in EQ.
gx-zita-rev1.description: The zita-rev1 eight-line feedback-delay-network reverb from the Faust library with guitarix defaults: pre-delay, low and mid RT60 with crossover, HF damping, two parametric EQ bands and dry/wet; wrapped to mono. A lush, natural hall.

gx-delay.name: Delay
gx-delay.shortDesc: Plain single-tap delay with gain and time.
gx-delay.description: A single delay line with Delay time and feedback Gain. A basic, clean digital delay.

gx-duck-delay.name: Duck Delay
gx-duck-delay.shortDesc: Ducking delay that fades the repeats down while you play and up when you stop.
gx-duck-delay.description: A feedback delay whose wet level is controlled by an envelope follower on the input: loud playing ducks the repeats, silence lets them through. Attack, Amount, Time, Feedback and Release, inspired by the Axe-FX ducking delay.

gx-echo.name: Echo
gx-echo.shortDesc: Simple echo with time and feedback percent.
gx-echo.description: A single feedback echo with Time and Percent (feedback) controls. A basic slapback-to-repeat echo.

gx-mbdel.name: Multi-Band Delay
gx-mbdel.shortDesc: Five-band delay with independent time, gain and feedback per band.
gx-mbdel.description: Splits the signal at four adjustable crossovers and applies a separate feedback delay (Delay, Gain, Feedback) to each band. Frequency-dependent rhythmic echoes.

gx-mbe.name: Multi-Band Echo
gx-mbe.shortDesc: Five-band echo with independent time and feedback percent per band.
gx-mbe.description: Splits the signal at four adjustable crossovers and applies a separate echo (Time, Percent) to each band. Frequency-dependent echo textures.

gx-stereodelay.name: Stereo Delay
gx-stereodelay.shortDesc: Two-channel delay with independent L/R time and gain plus an LFO; summed to mono here.
gx-stereodelay.description: Independent left and right delay times and gains with an LFO modulator; wrapped to mono for the pedal, so it behaves as a dual-tap delay.

gx-stereoecho.name: Stereo Echo
gx-stereoecho.shortDesc: Two-channel echo with independent L/R time and feedback plus an LFO; summed to mono here.
gx-stereoecho.description: Independent left and right echo times and feedback percentages with an LFO modulator; wrapped to mono for the pedal, so it behaves as a dual-tap echo.

gx-gxechocat.name: Copicat Tape Echo
gx-gxechocat.shortDesc: Watkins/Selmer Copicat-style multi-head tape echo with tube record/replay stages and wow.
gx-gxechocat.description: Tape echo built from real head spacings and tape speed (four playback heads), with DK-simulated record and replay valve stages from the Copicat circuit, band-limited tape filtering and a little wow. BPM sets head timing, Swell the repeats and Sustain the feedback.

gx-gxtubedelay.name: Tube Delay
gx-gxtubedelay.shortDesc: Up to 2.5 s delay wrapped in 12AX7 input and output tube stages with filtered feedback.
gx-gxtubedelay.description: A feedback delay (up to 2.5 s) placed between 12AX7 input and output tube-table stages, with a high/low-pass in the feedback loop to prevent runaway. Drive adds tube grit; Level, Feedback, Delay and Output complete the set.
